# A curated subset of the APFS directory-record name hashes that macOS
# stored in experiment E4 (docs/apfs-research.md), on macOS 26.6.2 build
# 25G83 with volumes formatted by newfs_apfs (2811.160.7.0.4). Captures:
# apfs-newfs-268435456-e4-names-ci (case-insensitive, incompatible feature
# 0x1), apfs-newfs-268435456-e4-names-cs (case-sensitive and
# normalization-insensitive, incompatible feature 0x8), and
# apfs-newfs-33554432-e4-prefix-ci and -cs for the p/pirhv and q/qodfh pairs.
# e4-vectors.txt beside the captures holds all 33369 stored names of the two
# large captures; the p/pirhv and q/qodfh lines come from the prefix captures.
# Fields, tab-separated: the stored name bytes in hex without the NUL, the
# personality (ci or cs), the stored length field (bytes with the NUL), and
# the stored 22-bit hash in decimal.
